notice: Stated height errors of the terrain for the uncertainty band (SPEC 5.7). A scenario carries one of these models, or its own, in uncertainty.dem_height_error_model; the package repeats it with every band. The default is measured by the data stream; the constants are illustrative values kept selectable.

lola-two-sigma-2026-11.label: Two sigma for the LOLA products: on the 5 m site rasters twice the producers' RMS error map at the pixel (1 m where the map is empty); on every other product 5 m up to 30 degrees of slope and 7 m above
lola-two-sigma-2026-11.source: Data stream, 14 November 2026: data/checkpoints/near_field_report.json (20 m product minus 5 m site rasters, 0.64 to 1.1 million points per site, by slope class) and data/checkpoints/height_error_report.json; RMS maps *_toterr of the 5 m site rasters of Barker et al. (2021), read through lsn_data sample_quality. The RMS maps are the producers' model estimate, not a test against independent data. Every product is built from LOLA returns: errors common to all LOLA products are not covered.
